engineeringSkip.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter only exists in the crushing gravity of neutron stars and cannot be manufactured into a stable alloy shell, making this a science-fiction material rather than a technology grounded in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter only exists inside neutron stars, where gravity holds it together — a spoonful would explode the instant that pressure was removed, so it cannot be manufactured, stored or used as a shell.
